items.title: ConocoPhillips and Devon Energy Earnings Previews: What Shareholders Should Watch
items.summary: ConocoPhillips and Devon Energy both beat estimates last quarter, but swinging oil prices and activist pressure now threaten the generous payouts each company promised shareholders. Here is what the Nov. 5 reports need to show for those commitments to hold.

items.title: 6 Big Funds Bought Devon Energy. Is It a Buy Before Earnings?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSix funds managing $2 billion to $6 billion each in US stocks reported new stakes in Devon Energy (DVN:NYSE) in their 13Fs for the quarter ended June 30, and the stock is up 15% since. Analysts’ average target sits 27% above Devon’s price, while ConocoPhillips (COP:NYSE), EOG Resources (EOG:NYSE) and Canadian Natural Resources (CNQ) all trade near or above their own targets.
